title: bupleurum tenuissimum var. columnae
intro: Bupleurum tenuissimum var. columnae, commonly known as Chinese thin-stemmed bupleurum, is a plant species in the carrot family (Apiaceae). It has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, anti-bacterial, and anti-viral properties. The therapeutic actions of Bupleurum tenuissimum var. columnae include soothing the liver and relieving fever, as well as acting as a sedative and anti-anxiety agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
